clues: This town is the chief town of its half of a split land. It stands on a river in the north-west, in a land of thick woods.
Winters here are mild, and frosts are rare. Summers turn warm, with the peak heat in July.
This town marks the day it was freed at the end of the last great war as its town day, each spring.
This town was named a world city of music in 2023. Five years before, it won a sport crown for all of Europe.
This is the second most peopled town in its whole land. Its big school and health hub serve its whole half of the land.
